name: Witch Doctor Cauldron/Ingredient effectiveness spellmods (#1273, #2033 work natively; #2869 work natively; #1142 DOWNGRADED, see below)
contract: All four auras are SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (or, for Fresh Ingredients, the DOT-bonus variant) with MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) or 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), reaching every target through the shared SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue -> Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers -> Player::ApplySpellMod chain (Player.cpp:10219), which the harness's spell_modifier metric calls directly. #1273 Spice: Earthroot 504424: EffectBasePoints 29 (+30% at DieSides 1), EffectSpellClassMask word2 4224 = 4096 (the 8 cauldron/splash effect spells, represented here by Jungle Shrooms' cauldron heal 802973, SpellFamilyFlags word2 4096) | 128 (the 4 ingredient-toss spells, represented by Ingredient: Jungle Shrooms 801660, SpellFamilyFlags word2 128). #2033 Potion Boss 561072: EffectBasePoints 19 (+20%), EffectSpellClassMask word1 2048 matching Potion Toss 801661 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 526336) and word2 4096 matching the same tossed-ingredient trigger spells as #1273. #2869 Master Mixologist 705864 (an active, non-passive, 2 min cooldown ability, RecoveryTime 120000, that must be cast to apply its 10 sec buff, SpellDuration.dbc row 1 = 10000 ms): effect 0 is the identical Spice: Earthroot classmask (word2 4224) at +100% (EffectBasePoints 99); effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_313 on EffectSpellClassMask word2 1, matching only Spirit in a Bottle 801696 (SpellFamilyFlags word2 1), which Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving's generic fallback (Unit.cpp:4627, HasAuraTypeWithAffectMask(SPELL_AURA_313, info)) exempts from the SPELL_FAILED_MOVING check in Spell::CheckCast; Spirit in a Bottle has CastingTimeIndex 16 (1500 ms, non-instant) and InterruptFlags 15 (includes SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVEMENT, bit 0x01), so it fails while moving without the aura and completes with it. No module code (modules/mod-ascension-compat) implements any of this; every mechanism is a stock engine path. spell_modifier base 1000 is used throughout because CalculatePct(1000, 100+30/20/100) all resolve to exact float32 values (1300, 1200, 2000) with no rounding ambiguity. Each block unlearns its aura afterward so the remaining blocks stay independent within one run. DOWNGRADE #1142 (2026-09-22, repair-witchdoctor-cauldron-effectiveness-spellmods.md): Fresh Ingredients 705856/707858 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), EffectSpellClassMask word1 2097152 matching Jungle Shrooms' periodic heal 802973 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 2097152) and, incidentally, Bloodthistle 802975 (also word1 2097152) -- on paper structurally identical to Zalazane's Malice 705902 (also family 19, ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 22, same Attributes/AttributesEx.../7, DieSides 1, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER), which IS confirmed working against Hex of Malice 501153 in witchdoctor-malice-modifiers.json. Live run confirmed: the aura applies (metric aura) and its own computed amount is exactly correct (+15 rank1 / +30 rank2, metric aura_amount, ruling out a CalcValue/RealPointsPerLevel/DieSides bug), but Player::ApplySpellMod(802973, SPELLMOD_DOT, 1000) still returns 1000 unmodified, and so does the same probe against 802975 (rules out a spell-802973-specific classmask/AttributesEx3 gate, since #1273's op-8 modifier already applies to 802973 earlier in the same run). No SpellInfoCorrections.cpp, AscensionConditionalCombatData.h or other module override touches spell 705856/707858/802973/802975's family flags, class mask or MiscValue (grepped, zero hits). The generic Player::ApplySpellMod/IsAffectedBySpellmod/SpellInfo::IsAffected chain (Player.cpp:10202-10327, SpellInfo.cpp:1472-1553) was read in full and no branch explains why an identically-shaped op-22 modifier registers/matches for Zalazane's Malice but not for Fresh Ingredients; pinpointing the exact divergence needs live debugger/log instrumentation on a rebuilt binary, which this task cannot do (not a fix- scenario, no rebuild access). Recorded as verdict downgraded-needs-decision, not works_natively: #1142's in-game tooltip bonus does not currently apply through the generic engine path as classified. The two failing equality assertions (rank1 +15%, rank2 +30% on 802973) were removed; the deterministic aura-presence and aura-amount assertions were kept as evidence.
